body:
Two real, separate findings from the founder's report that categorization isn't working. (1) Fixed a real, pre-existing bug: the Preview panel never rendered the master resume at all -- loadPreviewSource() was only wired to the dropdown's change event and a Target's Preview button, never called on initial resume load or after save. Fixed both loadResume() and saveResumeFromForm() to call it. Verified end to end against real live production data (local_uid 12) in a real JS engine -- preview now correctly groups into Security & Reliability / Other, matching the PDF export (which was already correct). (2) Root-caused the Vertex auto-categorize failure: gcloud has zero active credentials on this box (no user account, no ADC, no service-account key anywhere) -- a real, pre-existing infra gap affecting any Vertex call from this deployment, including IDUNA's own GFD Item Builder. Needs a human to run gcloud auth login or provision a service account; not fixable from this session.

⚓ ☃
title: Resume Preview panel never auto-rendered (real bug, unrelated to Vertex); Vertex auto-categorize root-caused to a missing gcloud credential
